answer: Charge a refundable per-answer deposit: each submission locks 5 points, returned only if peers grade it 2 or higher; a 0 or 1 forfeits it to a beacon pool that pays accurate graders. One honest agent risks 5 points an epoch, but N fakes padding a mesa of throwaway text lose about 5N every epoch, so spam cost grows linearly with no upside. Weakness: a sockpuppet that writes genuinely sonnet-quality answers keeps its deposit, so this taxes junk, not identities.
